name: Bold Stance
text: Your team takes two fewer bags each round.

signature.effect: first two overtricks add no bags

archetypes: Contract Attacker, Bonus Chaser; splash Exact Contractor
decision: Bidding: you can bid safely a trick or two under your hand without the bags piling up.
opponent: Visible at scoring; Contract Attacker opponents who feed you overtricks get less from it.
aiNote: Bid one trick lower when the hand is uncertain.
rationale: Two bags a round avoided is about 20 points of penalty saved in rounds with overtricks, about +12 EV, so Bonus Chaser and Contract Attacker can bid safely and win extra tricks without the penalty.
deviation: Redesigned from a once-per-round raise of your bid after taking it, into direct bag relief.
